memory_candidates.content: A task spun off from a parent task's 'user decision required' follow-up can be silently superseded by the parent's own later /revise rounds. Before planning such a spin-off, read the parent's CURRENT plan artifact (specs/{parent}/plans/ highest-numbered file and specs/state.json's artifacts list), not the summary that generated the follow-up: a /revise round is the sanctioned route for changing a recorded Lean Challenge statement, so the decision the spin-off was created to make may already have been taken and landed there. In this repository the check is cheap -- grep the parent's current plan's '## Lean Challenge Statements' block for the proposed hypothesis, and grep the library for the proposed definition and its discharge lemma.
